== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|An Archmage is a highly skilled and certified magical practitioner recognized by the [[Galactic Union]]. These individuals are distinguished by their mastery of specific disciplines, such as [[water elementalism]], predictive divination, or the arts of sealing and [[binding]]. While most [[Archmagi]] possess a single pinnacle spell that defines their relationship with the [[Aether]], exceptional cases exist where a single individual can wield multiple sets of magic simultaneously through unique rituals. Such individuals are considered immense magical geniuses and possess power far exceeding that of multiple standard wizards. In terms of status, some [[Archmagi]] are classified as fleet-class threats due to their immense capabilities. They often serve in significant leadership or advisory roles, such as captains of vessels or royal advisors. The profession is characterized by a profound connection to their magical staves and the [[Aether]]. [[Archmagi]] can manifest as spirits or ghosts, retaining their expertise even after death, and may possess specialized abilities like interacting with the souls of sentient beings. Their magical output is so significant that large-scale clashes between them can impact entire sectors or continents.}}

== The Captain ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-01-the-captain|The rank of Archmage is a [[Union]]-certified level of wizardry earned through significant magical feats and specialized knowledge. [[Varic Vallenar]] holds this title, appearing as a dark-skinned human man with silver eyes who carries a [[wand]] and wears a blue hooded mantle. As a certified expert in [[sealing magic|binding and sealing magic]], he possesses the ability to bend the rules of magic and understand the sharing of [[Aetheric patterns]]. During operations, such as those involving a [[Union strike team]], an Archmage utilizes large-scale magic and maintains a profound bond with his staff.}}
